remarks: Enjoy privacy, comfort, and convenience in this exquisite four-bedroom, 2.5-bath home that beautifully blends classic elegance with modern sophistication. Step inside to discover an immaculate interior featuring hardwood floors throughout, a stunning designer kitchen, and a sunny breakfast nook. Unwind in the formal Living Room or the inviting Family Room, complete with a floor-to-ceiling brick fireplace. The charming Library/Office offers a warm and refined retreat with its own brick fireplace flanked by custom bookshelves. Indulge in the luxury of a newly remodeled primary bath, complemented by tastefully updated powder and second-floor bathrooms. The expansive screened porch-overlooking protected open space-provides a serene, private setting perfect for relaxation or hosting gatherings. Enhanced by a new driveway and a welcoming entrance framed by stone walls, the home boasts exceptional curb appeal. Ideally situated on a lovely cul-de-sac just minutes from Wilton's top-rated schools, train station, shopping, and dining, this residence offers the perfect blend of neighborhood charm and commuter convenience. Don't miss the opportunity to make this pristine home your own.  .
